svg.title: Dendrogram
svg.desc: Hierarchical clustering dendrogram with unequal branch lengths, leaves, labels, and a cut threshold. Biological basis: A dendrogram records agglomerative merge order and height; a horizontal cut defines clusters at a chosen dissimilarity.
